doc: FBL 0.16, sections 4.9 (A part that goes with its separator), 5.3 (a place of its own for each entry on one line), 6.2 (`parts`, `whole`) and 6.3, spec 067: a removal takes one separator, and the whole statement when it is the last. Each is one `remove-entry`, and an undo restores every byte.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
steps.expect:
ann knows bob , cat ;
  likes dan ;
  age 42 .
eve knows fay ; likes gil .  # kept
# stays above
hal knows ivy .  # goes
jay knows kim , lee , mia .
nan knows ola ; # note
  likes pat .
qed
  knows rob ;
  likes sam .
